title: Free Realms New Adventures TV Commercial
names_seen: Free Realms New Adventures TV Commercial

facts.statement: Free Realms released a new TV commercial, viewable on the page and on the Free Realms Online YouTube channel, featuring activities such as dragon flying, bike riding, house building, outfit showing and farming.
facts.quote: Check it out and see if you can spot some of your favorite activities like swooping around on a dragon, riding a bike, creating a really cool house

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A SOE news post announcing a new Free Realms TV commercial, which shows activities such as flying on a dragon, riding a bike, building a house, showing off outfits, and farming. The post gives no dates beyond a relative '1 month, 1 week ago' stamp, and no mechanics, prices or quest details.
